sp: Doom Metal instrumental. Down-tuned electric guitar plays crushing, sustained power chords with heavy distortion and agonizing slow bends. Bass guitar provides a thick, rumbling low-end foundation that mirrors the guitar riffs with immense weight. The drums feature slow, deliberate hits on the floor tom and crash cymbal with a plodding, hypnotic groove. The arrangement is monolithic and oppressive, building through layers of feedback and droning repetition. 45 BPM in Ab Minor, 4/4 time signature.

Dark Ambient instrumental. Dissonant synth pad provides an eerie, evolving wall of dissonance with slow filter sweeps across the stereo field. Sub-drone creates an ominous low-frequency presence that rumbles beneath the surface. Granular texture produces shifting, fragmented particles of sound that drift unpredictably through the mix. The arrangement is formless and atmospheric, with elements fading in and out of a vast, dark space. 35 BPM in Ab Minor, 4/4 time signature.

Neo-Soul instrumental. Rhodes electric piano plays warm, jazzy chords with gentle tremolo and a soft, pillowy attack. Fretless bass provides smooth, gliding melodic lines with a round, woody tone and subtle vibrato. Finger snaps create an intimate, organic rhythmic pulse alongside a light hi-hat shuffle. The arrangement is laid-back and groove-driven, with spacious dynamics and a silky, late-night feel. 65 BPM in Ab Major, 6/8 time signature.

Film Score instrumental. Full orchestra provides sweeping, cinematic phrases with lush string sections and dramatic dynamic swells. French horn plays a noble, soaring melody with rich, warm tone and heroic phrasing. Timpani provides deep, resonant rolls and punctuating accents that underscore the dramatic peaks. The arrangement is through-composed with rising tension, climactic brass fanfares, and gentle woodwind interludes. 55 BPM in Ab Major, 3/4 time signature.

Big Band Swing instrumental. Brass section plays punchy, syncopated stabs and bright, blaring ensemble hits with tight voicings. Tenor saxophone features a smooth, swinging solo with bluesy inflections and rapid bebop runs. The drums feature a driving swing pattern on the ride cymbal with crisp snare accents on two and four. The arrangement is energetic and danceable, with call-and-response between brass and saxophone sections. 185 BPM in Bb Major, 4/4 time signature.

Reggae instrumental. Clean electric guitar plays offbeat skanks with a tight, choppy rhythm and bright tone. Deep bass guitar provides a heavy, melodic bassline with a warm, rounded tone and subtle slides between notes. The drums feature a classic one-drop pattern with cross-stick on the snare and sparse hi-hat. The arrangement is spacious and groove-driven, with echo-drenched guitar stabs and dub-style mixing effects. 78 BPM in Bb Minor, 4/4 time signature.

New Orleans Jazz instrumental. Trombone plays a warm, sliding melody with tailgate-style smears and brassy vibrato. Clarinet features high, nimble countermelodies with a sweet, piercing tone and ornamental trills. Tuba provides a bouncing bass line in a two-beat pattern with a deep, resonant tone. The arrangement follows collective improvisation style, with all instruments weaving together in joyful polyphony. 118 BPM in Bb Major, 4/4 time signature.

Polka instrumental. Accordion plays a bright, lively melody with rapid bellows changes and crisp staccato phrasing. Tuba provides a steady oom-pah bass pattern with alternating root notes and fifths on the offbeat. Clarinet features playful, dancing countermelodies with trills and grace notes above the ensemble. The arrangement is cheerful and bouncy, with a simple AABB structure and festive, dance-hall energy. 135 BPM in Bb Major, 2/4 time signature.

Progressive Metal instrumental. Distorted electric guitar plays complex, shifting riffs with palm-muted chugging and odd-meter phrasing. Bass guitar provides aggressive, technical lines that interlock with the guitar in tight unison passages. The drums feature double-kick patterns with polyrhythmic fills and precise hi-hat work. The arrangement is structured as a suite with abrupt tempo shifts, dissonant breakdowns, and soaring melodic passages. 155 BPM in F# Minor, 7/8 time signature.

Impressionist instrumental. Piano plays delicate, shimmering arpeggios with soft pedal sustain and whole-tone harmonic colors. Flute provides airy, floating melodies with breathy articulation and subtle vibrato. Harp features gentle glissandos and plucked chords that sparkle across the harmonic spectrum. The arrangement is through-composed and dreamlike, with pastel-colored textures that dissolve into silence. 48 BPM in F# Minor, 6/8 time signature.

Shoegaze instrumental. Heavily distorted electric guitar creates a dense, swirling wall of sound with layered feedback and tremolo bar dives. Bass guitar with flanger provides a thick, undulating low end that blends into the guitar wash. The drums feature steady kick and snare beneath waves of crash cymbal washes and heavy reverb. The arrangement is immersive and hypnotic, with buried melodies emerging from layers of distortion and noise. 98 BPM in F# Minor, 4/4 time signature.

Art Pop instrumental. Celesta plays sparkling, crystalline melodies with a music-box quality and delicate touch. Synthesizer provides lush, evolving pad textures with slow filter modulation and ethereal shimmer. Orchestral harp features cascading arpeggios and resonant plucked chords that bridge the harmonic shifts. The arrangement is unconventional and cinematic, with unexpected harmonic turns and asymmetric phrasing in five-four meter. 88 BPM in F# Major, 5/4 time signature.

Gospel instrumental. Hammond organ plays rich, soulful chords with a warm, overdriven Leslie speaker tone and bluesy fills. Piano provides rhythmic, percussive gospel comping with syncopated chords and rolling triplet figures. Choir delivers powerful, uplifting harmonies with call-and-response phrasing and soaring crescendos. The arrangement is deeply emotional, building from a quiet, reverent opening to a jubilant, full-voiced climax. 62 BPM in Eb Major, 12/8 time signature.

Bebop instrumental. Alto saxophone plays rapid, chromatic lines with angular phrasing and sharp, biting articulation over fast-moving changes. Piano provides dense, rhythmic comping with unexpected chord substitutions and brief solo bursts. The drums feature a constant ride cymbal swing with light, responsive snare and bass drum accents. The arrangement follows AABA form with virtuosic solo choruses over rapid harmonic movement. 210 BPM in Eb Major, 4/4 time signature.

Disco instrumental. Lush string section plays sweeping, euphoric phrases with sustained bow strokes and rising arpeggios. Four-on-the-floor kick drum provides a steady, driving pulse with a punchy, compressed attack. Electric bass plays a funky, syncopated groove with octave jumps and slapped ghost notes. The arrangement is danceable and glamorous, with shimmering hi-hats and orchestral builds into each chorus. 125 BPM in Eb Minor, 4/4 time signature.

Waltz instrumental. String orchestra plays elegant, sweeping phrases with rich vibrato and graceful bowing across lush, romantic harmonies. Grand piano provides sparkling, flowing accompaniment with arpeggiated left-hand patterns and delicate melodic ornaments. Harp features gentle, cascading glissandos that bridge musical phrases with crystalline clarity. The arrangement is refined and ballroom-elegant, with natural dynamic rises and tender diminuendos. 170 BPM in Eb Major, 3/4 time signature.

Black Metal instrumental. Tremolo-picked electric guitar creates a buzzing, dissonant wall of rapid-fire notes with raw, lo-fi distortion. Blast beats drive relentless, machine-gun snare and bass drum patterns at extreme speed. Bass guitar provides a dark, growling undercurrent that reinforces the harmonic foundation beneath the tremolo wash. The arrangement is through-composed with atmospheric, haunting ambient passages breaking the relentless aggression. 195 BPM in C# Minor, 4/4 time signature.

Drone Ambient instrumental. Sustained synth pad creates an immense, slowly evolving harmonic drone with deep, resonant overtones. Sub-drone provides an almost subsonic low-frequency presence that vibrates at the threshold of hearing. Overtone singing produces haunting, ethereal harmonics that float above the drone field. The arrangement is vast and meditative, with imperceptible changes unfolding over long durations. 30 BPM in C# Minor, 4/4 time signature.

Trance instrumental. Supersaw lead synthesizer plays soaring, anthem-like melodies with bright, stacked detuned oscillators. Sidechained bass provides a pumping, rhythmic low end that ducks under each kick drum hit. Snare roll builds create escalating tension through rapid, crescendoing fills into euphoric drops. The arrangement follows a build-drop structure with atmospheric breakdowns and uplifting chord progressions. 142 BPM in C# Minor, 4/4 time signature.

Romantic Period instrumental. Grand piano plays expressive, rubato-laden melodies with rich, singing tone and dynamic contrasts from pianissimo to fortissimo. Solo violin features a passionate, lyrical theme with wide vibrato and soaring double stops. Orchestral strings provide warm, cushioning harmonies with gentle swells and tender pizzicato passages. The arrangement unfolds in ternary form with an intimate opening, a passionate climax, and a bittersweet return. 58 BPM in Db Major, 3/4 time signature.

Stoner Metal instrumental. Fuzzy down-tuned electric guitar plays thick, sludgy riffs with heavy fuzz distortion and slow, grinding bends. Bass guitar provides a massive, rumbling low end with overdriven tone and locked-in rhythmic grooves. The drums feature heavy, plodding beats with deep floor tom hits and loose, crashing cymbals. The arrangement is hypnotic and crushing, with repetitive riff cycles that build toward feedback-drenched climaxes. 55 BPM in Db Minor, 4/4 time signature.

Trip-Hop instrumental. Scratched vinyl textures provide a gritty, lo-fi crackle layered over downtempo beats. Atmospheric strings play dark, cinematic phrases with slow, legato bowing and reverb-soaked sustain. Deep bass provides a heavy, sub-weighted foundation with minimal, deliberate melodic movement. The arrangement is moody and cinematic, with sparse, echo-laden elements drifting through a shadowy sonic landscape. 82 BPM in Db Minor, 4/4 time signature.

Bluegrass instrumental. Banjo plays rapid, rolling fingerpicked patterns with bright, metallic tone and syncopated three-finger picking. Mandolin features crisp, tremolo-picked melodies and driving, rhythmic chop chords on the backbeat. Upright bass provides a steady, thumping walking bass line with a warm, woody tone and solid root-fifth movement. The arrangement is lively and virtuosic, with trading solos between banjo and mandolin over a driving rhythm. 160 BPM in A Major, 4/4 time signature.

Flamenco instrumental. Nylon-string guitar plays passionate, rapid-fire rasgueado strumming and intricate picado runs with percussive golpe taps on the body. Cajon provides driving, syncopated rhythms with deep bass slaps and crisp, snappy edge hits. Hand claps create complex, interlocking palmas patterns with sharp, precise accents. The arrangement is fiery and through-composed, with dramatic pauses, accelerating passages, and intense dynamic contrasts. 95 BPM in A Phrygian, 12/8 time signature.

Surf Rock instrumental. Spring reverb guitar plays twangy, staccato melodies with heavy reverb, tremolo picking, and rapid descending glissandos. Upright bass provides a driving, walking bass line with a punchy, slapped tone and rockabilly edge. The drums feature a relentless, galloping floor tom pattern with splashy crash cymbal accents. The arrangement is energetic and retro, with raw, garage-band energy and reverb-drenched guitar leads. 165 BPM in A Minor, 4/4 time signature.

Thrash Metal instrumental. Electric guitar plays aggressive palm-muted riffs with tight, machine-gun precision and searing lead breaks. Bass guitar provides a punchy, distorted low end with rapid-fire sixteenth-note picking that mirrors the guitar attack. The drums feature relentless double-kick patterns with razor-sharp snare hits and explosive cymbal crashes. The arrangement is intense and unrelenting, with breakneck riffs, a shredding guitar solo, and a crushing breakdown. 200 BPM in A Minor, 4/4 time signature.

Funeral Doom instrumental. Extremely slow electric guitar drone plays glacial, sustained power chords with massive distortion and endless feedback. Organ provides deep, mournful sustained chords with a hollow, cavernous tone that fills the low frequencies. Sparse timpani delivers rare, thunderous hits that punctuate the oppressive silence between notes. The arrangement is devastatingly slow, with each chord decaying into vast, echoing emptiness. 25 BPM in Db Minor, 4/4 time signature.

Ambient Minimalist instrumental. Sustained piano notes ring out with long decay, creating overlapping harmonic resonances in a sparse, contemplative texture. Tape loop provides a gently warbling, repeating melodic fragment with warm analog degradation. Silence is used as a compositional element, with extended pauses between sparse, isolated gestures. The arrangement is meditative and reductive, with minimal material stretched across a vast, open soundscape. 35 BPM in F# Minor, 3/4 time signature.

Speedcore instrumental. Distorted kick drum fires at extreme tempo with a crushing, overdriven thud that dominates the mix. Noise synthesizer produces harsh, abrasive textures with rapid pitch sweeps and aggressive modulation. Gabber bass provides a relentless, distorted low-end assault with pounding, repetitive patterns. The arrangement is chaotic and brutal, with unrelenting intensity and zero dynamic relief from start to finish. 250 BPM in A Minor, 4/4 time signature.

Fast Bebop instrumental. Tenor saxophone plays blazing, virtuosic lines with rapid chromatic runs, wide intervallic leaps, and breathless phrasing. Piano provides frenetic comping with sharp, angular chord stabs and lightning-fast solo breaks. The drums feature a feathered bass drum with explosive ride cymbal patterns and unpredictable snare accents. The arrangement follows AABA form at breakneck tempo with extended improvisation over rapid harmonic changes. 280 BPM in Bb Major, 4/4 time signature.

Balkan Brass instrumental. Trumpet plays a bright, ornamented melody with rapid grace notes and passionate, wailing phrases in an asymmetric groove. Tuba provides a bouncing, syncopated bass pattern that navigates the seven-eight meter with heavy, percussive accents. Snare drum drives a tight, galloping rhythm with sharp rim shots and rolls that propel the dance forward. The arrangement is festive and exuberant, with tutti brass climaxes and virtuosic solo breaks. 140 BPM in Ab Minor, 7/8 time signature.

Progressive Rock instrumental. 12-string electric guitar plays shimmering, arpeggiated patterns with a wide, chorus-laden stereo spread and complex chord voicings. Mellotron provides lush, orchestral string and flute textures with a warm, analog character and slow-attack swells. Bass guitar features melodic, adventurous lines with a clean, punchy tone and fluid position shifts. The arrangement is structured as a suite with shifting moods, unexpected time changes, and dynamic contrasts. 108 BPM in Eb Minor, 5/4 time signature.

Carnatic Fusion instrumental. Mridangam, a double-headed drum, plays intricate rhythmic patterns with complex subdivisions and crisp finger strokes. Violin features expressive, ornamented melodies with fast gamakas and sliding microtonal inflections in a South Indian classical style. Veena, a plucked string instrument with a resonant, bell-like tone, provides melodic counterpoint with rich sustain. The arrangement blends Carnatic rhythmic complexity with contemporary fusion harmony. 90 BPM in A Minor, 7/8 time signature.

Turkish Psychedelic instrumental. Electric saz plays a hypnotic, distorted melody with buzzing microtonal bends and rapid tremolo picking in a sinuous Eastern scale. Organ provides swirling, psychedelic textures with heavy vibrato and a warm, overdriven tone. Fuzzy guitar creates a thick, wah-drenched rhythm with trippy, phaser-soaked chords and feedback swells. The arrangement is trance-inducing, with spiraling melodic development over an asymmetric nine-eight groove. 115 BPM in Bb Minor, 9/8 time signature.

Math Rock instrumental. Tapping electric guitar plays intricate, two-handed tapping patterns with clean, bell-like harmonics and rapid, angular melodic phrases. Bass guitar provides a punchy, syncopated foundation with slap technique and complex rhythmic interplay against the guitar. The drums feature constantly shifting polyrhythmic patterns with precise hi-hat work and unexpected accent placements. The arrangement is through-composed, with interlocking parts creating a tight, puzzle-like structure. 145 BPM in F# Minor, 11/8 time signature.

Viennese Waltz instrumental. String orchestra plays graceful, spinning melodies with elegant legato phrasing and lush, romantic harmonies at a brisk tempo. Flute provides a bright, singing countermelody with light, airy articulation and tasteful ornaments. Timpani delivers subtle, rolling accents that mark the downbeat of each phrase with warm, resonant tone. The arrangement is refined and spirited, with sweeping crescendos and graceful dynamic tapering through each dance section. 180 BPM in A Major, 3/4 time signature.

Jazz Waltz instrumental. Piano plays sophisticated, extended chord voicings with a light, swinging touch and melodic improvisation. Upright bass provides a warm, walking bass line in three-four with smooth bow changes and subtle slides between notes. Brush drums create a gentle, swishing rhythm with soft, circular snare patterns and understated kick accents. The arrangement is elegant and conversational, with trading phrases and relaxed, flowing dynamics. 155 BPM in Eb Major, 3/4 time signature.

Celtic Folk instrumental. Tin whistle plays a bright, lilting jig melody with quick ornamental cuts, rolls, and crans in a traditional Irish style. Bodhran provides a driving, rhythmic pulse with a warm, resonant tone and subtle dynamic accents using a tipper. Fiddle features a lively, bowing-intensive countermelody with rhythmic double stops and slides. The arrangement is spirited and dance-like, with strophic repetitions and building energy through each variation. 125 BPM in Ab Major, 6/8 time signature.

Tarantella instrumental. Mandolin plays rapid, tremolo-picked melodies with a bright, metallic ring and driving, dance-like phrasing. Tambourine provides a constant, jingling rhythmic pulse with sharp accents on the upbeats and rapid shaking rolls. Accordion features spirited, bellows-driven chords and melodic fills with a warm, reedy tone. The arrangement is frenzied and exuberant, with accelerating passages and infectious, spinning dance energy. 175 BPM in A Minor, 6/8 time signature.

Military March instrumental. Brass band plays bold, fanfare-like phrases with crisp, martial articulation and bright, unified ensemble tone. Snare drum provides a precise, regimented cadence with tight rolls and sharp flam accents in a traditional marching pattern. Piccolo features a bright, piercing countermelody that soars above the brass with rapid, ornamented runs. The arrangement follows traditional march form with trio section, strong downbeats, and disciplined, processional character. 120 BPM in Bb Major, 2/4 time signature.
